name: Whispers Beneath Ravenhollow
description: A sleepy New England town harbors cosmic horrors that have slumbered for millennia.
seed_prompt: A Lovecraftian horror setting where investigators uncover terrible truths about their seemingly ordinary town.
lore_content:
Ravenhollow, Massachusetts has existed since 1692, though you won't find it on any map. The town appears only to those who need to find it - or those it needs to find.

Sheriff Thomas Crane maintains order in Ravenhollow with gruff practicality. He knows something is wrong with his town but refuses to acknowledge what he's seen in the old cemetery at night. His pragmatic denial protects his sanity but leaves others vulnerable.

Dr. Eleanor Marsh runs the Ravenhollow Historical Society from her family's colonial-era mansion. Her ancestors founded the town, and their journals contain rituals that should never be read aloud. She's spent her life studying these texts, and her mind has begun to fray at the edges.

The Whispering Library appears between the butcher shop and the bank only on nights of the new moon. Its librarian, Mr. Ash, seems too thin and too tall, and his eyes have no whites. He offers forbidden knowledge to those desperate enough to pay his price.

Beneath Founders' Hill lies the Temple of the Dreaming God. The cultists of the Pallid Congregation gather there monthly, led by Father Edmund, the town's beloved pastor. By day he preaches Christian charity; by night he prepares for the Awakening.

Olivia Chen arrived in Ravenhollow three months ago, investigating her brother's disappearance. A journalist by trade, she's begun documenting the town's anomalies. The more she learns, the more she realizes she may never be allowed to leave.

The Thing in the Well has no name that human tongues can speak. It predates the town, the land, the world itself. Sometimes it takes the form of a child asking for help. Those who peer into the old stone well behind the church see their own face staring back - but the reflection doesn't match their movements.

origins.name: Ravenhollow Native
origins.description: Born and raised in Ravenhollow, you know its secrets, and it knows you.
traits: Local Knowledge: Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate within Ravenhollow and its immediate surroundings.

origins.name: Recent Arrival
origins.description: Drawn to Ravenhollow by fate or misfortune, you are still learning its strange ways.
traits: Unsettled Feeling: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

origins.name: Marsh Lineage
origins.description: Descended from the founders of Ravenhollow, your family history is intertwined with the town's darkest secrets.
traits: Inherited Knowledge: You know one additional language of your choice.

origins.name: Crane's Legacy
origins.description: A descendant of law enforcement, you are naturally skeptical, but prepared for anything.
traits: Street Smart: Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to determine if someone is lying to you.

origins.name: Dream-Touched
origins.description: You have experienced visions, dreams or contact with entities beyond human comprehension.
traits: Lingering Visions: Once per long rest, you can gain advantage on an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

archetypes.name: Town Protector
archetypes.description: A stalwart defender of Ravenhollow, whether the town wants protecting or not.

features.name: Prepared for the Worst
features.description: You gain advantage on saving throws against being surprised.

archetypes.name: Occult Investigator
archetypes.description: Driven by curiosity or a thirst for forbidden knowledge, you delve into Ravenhollow's hidden lore.

features.name: Ritualistic Studies
features.description: You have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to understand or decipher magical texts.

archetypes.name: Unseen Protector
archetypes.description: A wanderer or private detective, you follow the whispers, seeking to understand the darkness.

archetypes.name: Enlightened One
archetypes.description: A member of a forbidden faith, fighting for the souls of Ravenhollow.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Protection
features.description: As an action, you can interpose divine protection between yourself and an enemy. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.

setting_skills.name: Streetwise
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of the urban underground and ability to read people.
